item.text: The NSW Independent Commission Against Corruption outlines better practice to help agencies assess and improve their corruption controls.
item.support: It aims to facilitate agencies to assess the maturity of their corruption control programs and identify any immature elements.
item.section: Mature corruption control: the key outcomes of better practice

item.text: Its framework covers building integrity, prevention, detection and responses to integrity breaches.
item.support: Better practice corruption control is built on four key pillars of control

item.text: The Commission cautions that adopting many controls is insufficient if they do not match agency risks or are poorly implemented.
item.support: The adoption of a broad range of controls is, by itself, insufficient to ensure good corruption control.

item.text: Its guidance calls for supporting arrangements for risk management, control frameworks, staff responsibilities and competence.
item.support: specific systems and processes that work together to support the implementation of an agency’s corruption control program

item.quote: The adoption of a broad range of controls is, by itself, insufficient to ensure good corruption control.
